```{r}
# convert to matrix (important for many bioinformatics tools)
counts_mat <- as.matrix(counts_HPV_Independent)

# remove duplicated gene symbols if any
counts_mat <- counts_mat[!duplicated(rownames(counts_mat)), ]

# create edgeR object
dge <- DGEList(counts = counts_mat)

# TMM normalization (library size normalization)
dge <- calcNormFactors(dge)

# CPM expression matrix
cpm_mat <- cpm(dge, log = FALSE)
```


```{r}

length(qti$cell_type)

analysis_data <- qti_long %>%
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS: convergence + cut-point tables
# ============================================================================

check_convergence <- function(model, maxit_val) {
  n_iter <- model$iter
  !is.null(n_iter) && all(n_iter < maxit_val) && is.finite(sum(model$coefficients))
}

make_cutoff_table <- function(data, event_var) {
  counts_one <- function(group_col, label) {
    data %>%
      group_by(cell_type, Group = .data[[group_col]]) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), events = sum(.data[[event_var]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(threshold_type = label)
  }
  counts <- bind_rows(counts_one("Group_maxstat", "maxstat"),
                      counts_one("Group_median",  "median")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Group, values_from = c(n, events), values_fill = 0)

  data %>%
    distinct(cell_type, cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(cutoff_maxstat, cutoff_median),
                 names_to = "threshold_type", values_to = "cutoff") %>%
    mutate(threshold_type = sub("cutoff_", "", threshold_type)) %>%
    left_join(counts, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    transmute(cell_type, threshold_type,
              cutoff = signif(cutoff, 3),
              `n (Low/High)`      = paste0(n_Low, "/", n_High),
              `Events (Low/High)` = paste0(events_Low, "/", events_High))
}

add_cutoffs <- function(tab, cutoff_table) {
  tab <- tab %>%
    left_join(cutoff_table, by = c("cell_type", "threshold_type")) %>%
    relocate(cutoff, `n (Low/High)`, `Events (Low/High)`, .after = threshold_type)
  if ("Variable" %in% names(tab)) {
    keep <- grepl("^Enrichment", tab$Variable)
    tab[!keep, c("cutoff", "n (Low/High)", "Events (Low/High)")] <- NA
  }
  tab$converged <- ifelse(tab$converged, "Yes", "No")
  tab
}
```



#Death
```{r}
# ============================================================================
# QUANTISEQ / QTI DOWNSTREAM SURVIVAL ANALYSIS
# DSS + RFS
# maxstat + median + continuous Fraction
# Cox-Firth multivariable models
# Schoenfeld PH diagnostics
# Bootstrap optimism correction
# ============================================================================



# ============================================================================
# 0. REQUIRED PACKAGES
# ============================================================================

library(edgeR)
library(maxstat)


# ============================================================================
# 1. REFERENCE LEVELS
# ============================================================================

analysis_data$figo_ini_ava <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$figo_ini_ava),
  ref = "1 (Advanced)"
)

analysis_data$p53_ihc_status <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$p53_ihc_status),
  ref = "Mutant"
)


# ============================================================================
# 2. MAXSTAT CUTOFF FUNCTION
# ============================================================================

find_maxstat_cutoff <- function(
  time_var,
  event_var,
  fraction_var,
  data
) {

  n <- nrow(data)

  if (n < 10) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  frac <- data[[fraction_var]]

  frac <- frac[
    is.finite(frac)
  ]

  if (length(frac) < 10) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  min_size <- n * 0.45
  max_size <- n * 0.55

  if (
    sum(
      frac >= min(frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) < min_size ||
    sum(
      frac <= max(frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ) < max_size
  ) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "survival::Surv(",
      time_var,
      ", ",
      event_var,
      ") ~ ",
      fraction_var
    )
  )

  MAXSTAT <- tryCatch(
    maxstat::maxstat.test(
      fmla,
      data = data,
      smethod = "LogRank",
      pmethod = "Lau92",
      iscores = TRUE,
      minprop = 0.2,
      maxprop = 0.8
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(MAXSTAT)) {
    return(NA_real_)
  }

  MAXSTAT$estimate
}


# ============================================================================
# 3. ADD MAXSTAT + MEDIAN GROUPS
# ============================================================================

add_threshold_groups <- function(
  df,
  time_var,
  event_var,
  fraction_var = "Fraction"
) {

  df %>%
    group_by(cell_type) %>%
    mutate(

      cutoff_maxstat = tryCatch(
        find_maxstat_cutoff(
          time_var,
          event_var,
          fraction_var,
          cur_data_all()
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      ),

      Group_maxstat = ifelse(
        !is.na(cutoff_maxstat) &
          .data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_maxstat,
        "High",
        "Low"
      ),

      cutoff_median = median(
        .data[[fraction_var]],
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),

      Group_median = ifelse(
        .data[[fraction_var]] > cutoff_median,
        "High",
        "Low"
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```


```{r}
analysis_data <- add_threshold_groups(
  analysis_data,
  time_var = "time_death_surv_60m",
  event_var = "death_disease_60m",
  fraction_var = "Fraction"
)

analysis_data$Group_maxstat <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_maxstat),
  ref = "Low"
)

analysis_data$Group_median <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_median),
  ref = "Low"
)

cutoffs_DSS_qti <- make_cutoff_table(analysis_data, event_var = "death_disease_60m")
cutoffs_DSS_qti

# ============================================================================
# DSS UNIVARIATE GROUPED
# ============================================================================

run_cox_DSS_group <- function(
  ct,
  exposure_var,
  threshold_label,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  df <- filter(
    analysis_data,
    cell_type == ct
  )

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
      exposure_var
    )
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = df,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = ct,
        threshold_type = threshold_label,
        coef = NA,
        HR = NA,
        lower_095 = NA,
        upper_095 = NA,
        pval = NA,
        n = nrow(df),
        n_events = sum(
          df$death_disease_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients,
    HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower,
    upper_095 = s$ci.upper,
    pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df),
    n_events = sum(
      df$death_disease_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    converged = check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  )
}


cell_types_all <- unique(
  analysis_data$cell_type
)

univ_DSS_maxstat_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DSS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
    threshold_label = "maxstat"
  )
)

univ_DSS_median_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DSS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_median",
    threshold_label = "median"
  )
)


# ============================================================================
# DSS UNIVARIATE CONTINUOUS
# ============================================================================

run_cox_DSS_continuous <- function(
  ct,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  df <- filter(
    analysis_data,
    cell_type == ct
  )

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      Surv(
        time_death_surv_60m,
        death_disease_60m
      ) ~ Fraction,
      data = df,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = ct,
        threshold_type = "continuous",
        coef = NA,
        HR = NA,
        lower_095 = NA,
        upper_095 = NA,
        pval = NA,
        n = nrow(df),
        n_events = sum(
          df$death_disease_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    threshold_type = "continuous",
    coef = s$coefficients,
    HR = exp(s$coefficients),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower,
    upper_095 = s$ci.upper,
    pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df),
    n_events = sum(
      df$death_disease_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    converged = check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  )
}


univ_DSS_continuous_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_DSS_continuous
  )
)


# ============================================================================
# DSS UNIVARIATE COMBINED + BH
# ============================================================================

univ_DSS_all_sensitivity <- bind_rows(
  univ_DSS_maxstat_all,
  univ_DSS_median_all,
  univ_DSS_continuous_all
) %>%
  group_by(threshold_type) %>%
  mutate(
    p_adj_BH = p.adjust(
      pval,
      method = "BH"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted <-
  univ_DSS_all_sensitivity %>%
  mutate(
    HR_CI = sprintf(
      "%.3f (%.3f–%.3f)",
      HR,
      lower_095,
      upper_095
    ),
    pval = round(
      pval,
      4
    ),
    p_adj_BH = round(
      p_adj_BH,
      4
    )
  ) %>%
  select(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type,
    HR_CI,
    pval,
    p_adj_BH,
    n,
    n_events,
    n_iter,
    converged
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type
  )

univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted <- add_cutoffs(univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted, cutoffs_DSS_qti)
kable(univ_DSS_all_sensitivity_formatted)
```



```{r}


# ============================================================================
#  SELECT CELL TYPES FOR MULTIVARIATE DSS ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================
#
# UNION across maxstat, median and continuous.
#
# Therefore, if a cell type has BH-adjusted p < 0.1 under ANY
# univariate approach, it enters ALL THREE multivariate models.
# ============================================================================

selected_cell_types_DSS <- univ_DSS_all_sensitivity %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_adj_BH),
    p_adj_BH < 0.1
  ) %>%
  pull(cell_type) %>%
  unique()


cat(
  "Cell types entering ALL DSS multivariate models ",
  "(maxstat, median, continuous):\n"
)

print(
  selected_cell_types_DSS
)


# ============================================================================
#  SHOW WHICH UNIVARIATE THRESHOLD(S) SELECTED EACH CELL TYPE
# ============================================================================

selection_summary_DSS <- univ_DSS_all_sensitivity %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(p_adj_BH),
    p_adj_BH < 0.1
  ) %>%
  select(
    cell_type,
    threshold_type,
    pval,
    p_adj_BH
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    cell_type,
    p_adj_BH
  )


kable(
  selection_summary_DSS
)


# ============================================================================
#  REFERENCE LEVELS
# ============================================================================

analysis_data$figo_ini_ava <- relevel(
  factor(
    analysis_data$figo_ini_ava
  ),
  ref = "1 (Advanced)"
)

analysis_data$p53_ihc_status <- relevel(
  factor(
    analysis_data$p53_ihc_status
  ),
  ref = "Mutant"
)


# ============================================================================
#  COVARIATES
# ============================================================================

covariates_full <- c(
  "figo_ini_ava",
  "p53_ihc_status"
)


# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIATE DSS FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
#
# Used for:
#
#   - Group_maxstat
#   - Group_median
#
# Model:
#
# Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m)
#       ~ exposure + FIGO + p53
#
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_DSS <- function(
  cell_type,
  data,
  exposure_var,
  covariates,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(
      cell_type == !!cell_type
    )


  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ ",
      paste(
        c(
          exposure_var,
          covariates
        ),
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )


  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = d,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model failed
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = cell_type,
        variable = NA,
        coef = NA,
        HR = NA,
        lower_095 = NA,
        upper_095 = NA,
        pval = NA,
        n = nrow(d),
        n_events = sum(
          d$death_disease_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model successful
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  converged <- check_convergence(
    model,
    maxit_val
  )


  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(
      model$coefficients
    ),
    coef = model$coefficients,
    HR = exp(
      model$coefficients
    ),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower,
    upper_095 = model$ci.upper,
    pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d),
    n_events = sum(
      d$death_disease_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    converged = converged
  )
}


# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIATE DSS — MAXSTAT
# ============================================================================

multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected <- if (
  length(selected_cell_types_DSS) > 0
) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_DSS,
      perform_cox_analysis_DSS,
      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      threshold_type = "maxstat",
      .after = cell_type
    )

} else {

  data.frame()
}

} else {

# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIATE DSS — CONTINUOUS FRACTION
# ============================================================================
#
# Model:
#
# Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m)
#       ~ Fraction + FIGO + p53
#
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_DSS_continuous <- function(
  cell_type,
  data,
  covariates,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(
      cell_type == !!cell_type
    )


  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_death_surv_60m, death_disease_60m) ~ Fraction + ",
      paste(
        covariates,
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )


  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = d,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model failed
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = cell_type,
        variable = NA,
        coef = NA,
        HR = NA,
        lower_095 = NA,
        upper_095 = NA,
        pval = NA,
        n = nrow(d),
        n_events = sum(
          d$death_disease_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model successful
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  converged <- check_convergence(
    model,
    maxit_val
  )


  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,
    variable = names(
      model$coefficients
    ),
    coef = model$coefficients,
    HR = exp(
      model$coefficients
    ),
    lower_095 = model$ci.lower,
    upper_095 = model$ci.upper,
    pval = model$prob,
    n = nrow(d),
    n_events = sum(
      d$death_disease_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),
    converged = converged
  )
}


multiv_DSS_continuous_selected <- if (
  length(selected_cell_types_DSS) > 0
) {

  bind_rows(
    lapply(
      selected_cell_types_DSS,
      perform_cox_analysis_DSS_continuous,
      data = analysis_data,
      covariates = covariates_full
    )
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      threshold_type = "continuous",
      .after = cell_type
    )

} else {

  data.frame()
}


# ============================================================================
#  COMBINE ALL MULTIVARIATE DSS MODELS
# ============================================================================

multiv_DSS_selected <- bind_rows(
  multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected,
  multiv_DSS_median_selected,
  multiv_DSS_continuous_selected
)


# ============================================================================
#  BH CORRECTION FOR MULTIVARIATE EXPOSURE VARIABLES
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAXSTAT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected) > 0) {

  multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected <- multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = NA_real_
    )

  exposure_rows <- grepl(
    "^Group_maxstat",
    multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected$variable
  )

  multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected$p_adj_BH[
    exposure_rows
  ] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DSS_maxstat_selected$pval[
      exposure_rows
    ],
    method = "BH"
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MEDIAN
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_median_selected) > 0) {

  multiv_DSS_median_selected <- multiv_DSS_median_selected %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = NA_real_
    )

  exposure_rows <- grepl(
    "^Group_median",
    multiv_DSS_median_selected$variable
  )

  multiv_DSS_median_selected$p_adj_BH[
    exposure_rows
  ] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DSS_median_selected$pval[
      exposure_rows
    ],
    method = "BH"
  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(multiv_DSS_continuous_selected) > 0) {

  multiv_DSS_continuous_selected <- multiv_DSS_continuous_selected %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = NA_real_
    )

  exposure_rows <- (
    multiv_DSS_continuous_selected$variable == "Fraction"
  )

  multiv_DSS_continuous_selected$p_adj_BH[
    exposure_rows
  ] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_DSS_continuous_selected$pval[

    ],

  )
}
```

```{r}
analysis_data <- add_threshold_groups(
  analysis_data,
  time_var = "time_recurrence_surv_60m",
  event_var = "recurrence_60m",
  fraction_var = "Fraction"
)

analysis_data$Group_maxstat <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_maxstat),
  ref = "Low"
)

analysis_data$Group_median <- relevel(
  factor(analysis_data$Group_median),
  ref = "Low"
)

cutoffs_RFS_qti <- make_cutoff_table(analysis_data, event_var = "recurrence_60m")
cutoffs_RFS_qti

# ============================================================================
# RFS UNIVARIATE GROUPED
# ============================================================================

run_cox_RFS_group <- function(
  ct,
  exposure_var,
  threshold_label,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  df <- filter(
    analysis_data,
    cell_type == ct
  )

  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }

  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
      exposure_var
    )
  )

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = df,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = ct,
        threshold_type = threshold_label,
        coef = NA,
        HR = NA,
        lower_095 = NA,
        upper_095 = NA,
        pval = NA,
        n = nrow(df),
        n_events = sum(
          df$recurrence_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
    threshold_type = threshold_label,
    coef = s$coefficients,
    HR = exp(
      s$coefficients
    ),
    lower_095 = s$ci.lower,
    upper_095 = s$ci.upper,
    pval = s$prob,
    n = nrow(df),
    n_events = sum(
      df$recurrence_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),
     converged = check_convergence(model, maxit_val)
  )
}


cell_types_all <- unique(
  analysis_data$cell_type
)

univ_RFS_maxstat_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_RFS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
    threshold_label = "maxstat"
  )
)

univ_RFS_median_all <- bind_rows(
  lapply(
    cell_types_all,
    run_cox_RFS_group,
    exposure_var = "Group_median",
    threshold_label = "median"
  )
)

          df$recurrence_60m == 1,

        ),
        n_iter = NA,

      )
    )
  }

  s <- summary(model)

  data.frame(
    cell_type = ct,
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================

analysis_data$figo_ini_ava <- relevel(

covariates_full <- c(
  "figo_ini_ava",
  "p53_ihc_status"

# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIATE RFS FUNCTION
# ============================================================================
#
# Model:
#
# Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m)
#     ~ exposure + FIGO + p53
#
# ============================================================================

perform_cox_analysis_RFS <- function(
  cell_type,
  data,
  exposure_var,
  covariates,
  maxit_val = 100000
) {

  d <- data %>%
    filter(
      cell_type == !!cell_type
    )


  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Complete-case data for the variables in the model
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  model_vars <- c(
    "time_recurrence_surv_60m",
    "recurrence_60m",
    exposure_var,
    covariates
  )

  d <- d %>%
    filter(
      complete.cases(
        across(
          all_of(model_vars)
        )
      )
    )


  if (nrow(d) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Formula
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  fmla <- as.formula(
    paste0(
      "Surv(time_recurrence_surv_60m, recurrence_60m) ~ ",
      paste(
        c(
          exposure_var,
          covariates
        ),
        collapse = " + "
      )
    )
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Cox-Firth model
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  model <- tryCatch(
    coxphf(
      fmla,
      data = d,
      maxstep = 0.0001,
      maxit = maxit_val
    ),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model failed
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  if (is.null(model)) {

    return(
      data.frame(
        cell_type = cell_type,
        variable = NA_character_,
        coef = NA_real_,
        HR = NA_real_,
        lower_095 = NA_real_,
        upper_095 = NA_real_,
        pval = NA_real_,
        n = nrow(d),
        n_events = sum(
          d$recurrence_60m == 1,
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        n_iter = NA_character_,
        converged = FALSE
      )
    )
  }


  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------
  # Model successful
  # --------------------------------------------------------------------------

  converged <- check_convergence(
    model,
    maxit_val
  )


  data.frame(
    cell_type = cell_type,

    variable = names(
      model$coefficients
    ),

    coef = model$coefficients,

    HR = exp(
      model$coefficients
    ),

    lower_095 = model$ci.lower,

    upper_095 = model$ci.upper,

    pval = model$prob,

    n = nrow(d),

    n_events = sum(
      d$recurrence_60m == 1,
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),

    n_iter = paste(
      model$iter,
      collapse = ","
    ),

    converged = converged
  )
}


# ============================================================================
#  MULTIVARIATE RFS — MAXSTAT
# ============================================================================

multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected <- if (
  length(selected_cell_types_RFS) > 0
) {

  bind_rows(

      data = analysis_data,
      exposure_var = "Group_maxstat",
      covariates = covariates_full

    mutate(
      threshold_type = "maxstat",

} else {

  data.frame()
}

# ============================================================================
#  BH CORRECTION FOR MULTIVARIATE EXPOSURE VARIABLES
# ============================================================================
#
# BH correction is performed ONLY on the cell-type exposure.
#
# FIGO and p53 are covariates and are NOT BH corrected.
#
# Because coxphf expands factors:
#
#   Group_maxstat -> Group_maxstatHigh
#   Group_median  -> Group_medianHigh
#
# we identify exposure rows using grepl().
# ============================================================================


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MAXSTAT
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected) > 0) {

  multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected <-
    multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = NA_real_
    )

  exposure_rows <- grepl(
    "^Group_maxstat",
    multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected$variable
  )

  valid_rows <- exposure_rows &
    !is.na(
      multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected$pval
    )

  multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected$p_adj_BH[
    valid_rows
  ] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_RFS_maxstat_selected$pval[
      valid_rows
    ],
    method = "BH"
  )
}

  ] <- p.adjust(

    ],

  )
}


# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CONTINUOUS
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

if (nrow(multiv_RFS_continuous_selected) > 0) {

  multiv_RFS_continuous_selected <-
    multiv_RFS_continuous_selected %>%
    mutate(
      p_adj_BH = NA_real_
    )

  exposure_rows <-
    multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$variable ==
    "Fraction"

  valid_rows <- exposure_rows &
    !is.na(
      multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$pval
    )

  multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$p_adj_BH[
    valid_rows
  ] <- p.adjust(
    multiv_RFS_continuous_selected$pval[
      valid_rows
    ],
    method = "BH"
  )
}

multiv_RFS_selected <- bind_rows(
```
